sections.section_title: GPIO port output data register (GPIOx_ODR) (x = A, B, C, D, F)
sections.text_helper: Section 8.5.6 "GPIO port output data register (GPIOx_ODR) (x = A, B, C, D, F)" in chapter 8 (General-purpose I/Os (GPIO)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 190.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x14
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:16 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 15:0 ODy: Port output data I/O y (y = 15 to 0)
These bits can be read and written by software.
Note: For atomic bit set/reset, the OD bits can be individually set and/or reset by writing to the
GPIOx_BSRR register (x = A, B, C, D, F).
